scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.notes: AI powerhouse outcome: Search/YouTube monetization improves, Cloud exceeds 20% growth with ~30% margins, FCF funds renewed buybacks, and optionality contributes meaningfully.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.notes: Steady compounder: Search/YouTube remain dominant, Cloud grows mid-teens then slows, and EPS compounds ~8% while heavy AI investment limits near-term buybacks.

scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.notes: Moat pressure and capital intensity: AI agents erode Search, Cloud slows with margin pressure, persistent capex and dilution weaken per-share compounding, and regulation adds cost.

evidence_for: Q3 2026 Google Search & other revenue grew 12% YoY to $63.350 billion; the full-year positive-growth prediction remains open.
Q3 2026 Google Cloud revenue grew 103% to $30.709 billion with a 36.214% calculated operating margin.
The Gemini app reached one billion users and first-party model APIs processed nearly 32 billion tokens per minute.
evidence_against: Q3 2026 FCF was negative $9.065 billion and YTD FCF was negative $4.804 billion as capex exceeded operating cash flow.
YTD repurchases were zero versus $39.810 billion in the prior-year period, while Q3 diluted shares increased 1.352% YoY and Alphabet used external financing.
Q3 depreciation increased 49.153% YoY to $8.369 billion, with further returns dependent on utilization and monetization.
DOJ antitrust search remedies create uncertainty around default distribution agreements.
open_questions: What are revenue, inference cost, and contribution profit per AI Search query relative to traditional Search?
What are ex-TPU Cloud growth, TPU-system margins, and fully loaded returns on shared AI infrastructure?
Can TTM FCF recover while capex remains high, and will fully diluted shares resume declining?
What normalized operating EPS excludes securities marks, preferred dividends, and potential conversion dilution?

predictions.claim: Google Cloud reports annual operating margin > 12% in FY2025/2026
predictions.notes: Tests structural profitability and scale leverage of GCP and TPU fleet.

predictions.claim: Google Search & Other revenue growth remains positive YoY throughout 2026
predictions.notes: Validates resilience of core search moat against standalone AI agents.

decision_journal.situation: Q3 Search and Cloud growth remained strong, but negative FCF, zero YTD repurchases, and dilution required lower EPS-growth assumptions and a ten-year model horizon aligned with the thesis.
alternatives_rejected: Add on headline Cloud growth (rejected: ex-TPU economics and FCF returns remain unproven).
Trim on negative FCF alone (rejected: operating income and Search/Cloud growth remain strong and no thesis-kill trigger fired).

decision_journal.situation: Alphabet trading at ~24x forward P/E, reasonable valuation relative to hyperscaler peer group with high net cash.
alternatives_rejected: Increase allocation to max 25% (rejected: antitrust regulatory overhang warrants keeping dry powder).
Trim on DOJ headlines (rejected: underlying free cash flow generation and TPU advantage are durable).
